name: CFF Fluid Control Ltd
tagline: Niche Khopoli-based defence SME making fluid-control/piping systems and sonar-partnership equipment for Indian Navy submarines (Scorpene, P75I pipeline) - FY26 revenue +43% and PAT +64% with a 551 Cr order book (~2.6x revenue) and steady CFO insider buying, but already ~54x trailing PAT and FY26 operating cash flow sharply negative on working-capital build
business_overview: Incorporated 2012, CFF Fluid Control manufactures and services shipboard machinery - critical fluid-control component systems and test facilities for submarines and surface ships for the Indian Navy, plus mechanical equipment/systems for nuclear and clean-energy industries. Facility at Khopoli. Promoters/group have 20+ years in defence manufacturing; the company was set up specifically to serve MDL's Scorpene submarine programme. Partnered with Atlas Elektronik (TKMS subsidiary) - positions it in the supply chain for the ~$8-10bn Project-75I (6 additional submarines) alongside existing P75/Kalvari-class refit and surface-combatant (P17A, P15B, ASW corvette) work. Board approved SME-to-mainboard migration in 2026 (source: external-lead, @ankitbahuguna84, untrusted X triage, first_seen 2026-09-04).
fundamentals_table: Rs 209 Cr (+43% YoY) / Rs 39 Cr (+64% YoY, 18.8% PAT margin)
FY26 OCF -Rs 260 Cr (vs -Rs 32 Cr FY25) - driven by rise in short-term loans/advances and other current assets; cash on hand Rs 44 Cr
~54x trailing PAT (Rs 2,129 Cr / Rs 39 Cr) - already rich for a defence SME
fundamentals_narrative: Real, live inflection: FY26 revenue +43% and PAT +64% with margin expansion to 18.8%, a 551 Cr order book (2.6x revenue) confirmed for delivery by FY27 across submarine refit (HDW SSK, Kalvari P75), surface combatants and sonar systems, and a fresh P75I opportunity (6 more submarines, ~7yr delivery horizon, CFF already partnered via Atlas Elektronik). CFO has been steadily buying in the open market since Dec 2025 (now ~64,800 shares) - a genuine insider-conviction signal. Board approved SME-to-mainboard migration. Set against this: FY26 operating cash flow swung sharply negative (-Rs 260 Cr) on a build in advances/current assets - typical of a scaling defence-project business on milestone billing, but a real working-capital risk to watch, and the stock already trades at ~54x trailing PAT, pricing in much of the near-term growth.
technical_read: Not pulled (not escalated - decent Tier-A candidate but valuation already rich; WebSearch fundamentals sufficed for the four-box read).

Community closely tracks order flow (P75/P75I, Cochin Shipyard, GRSE orders), CFO's open-market buying (tracked post-by-post since Dec 2025), and the FY26 annual report orderbook disclosure (Jul 2026, 13 likes - most-liked post). No trusted-user directional 10x call found; sentiment is watchful-bullish on order flow, cautious on valuation and management communication.

bull_case: Live inflection, not a hoped-for one: FY26 revenue +43%, PAT +64%, margin expansion to 18.8%
551 Cr order book (2.6x FY26 revenue) with clear delivery visibility to FY27 across multiple naval programmes
P75I (~$8-10bn, 6 submarines) is a genuine multi-year pipeline; CFF already in the TKMS/Atlas Elektronik supply chain
CFO has bought steadily in the open market for 9+ months - real insider skin in the game
bear_case: Already ~54x trailing PAT - much of the near-term growth looks priced in
FY26 OCF sharply negative (-Rs 260 Cr) on rising advances/current assets - a real working-capital risk if it doesn't reverse
Management does not proactively communicate (no con-calls, doesn't respond to forum queries per multiple posts) - low information flow for a story this dependent on order timing
P75I award timing itself is not yet finalised (expected FY27 per posts) - single-programme dependency risk
Small-cap/SME liquidity and defence-sector order lumpiness
verdict_headline: Genuine live inflection (43%/64% growth, 551 Cr order book, steady CFO buying) in a real P75I-adjacent defence niche, but four-box score sits at 2.0 on rich valuation - label allowed only via the growth-exception carve-out, capped at Medium with an unconfirmed caveat pending the OCF reversal and P75I award.

Score 2.0-2.5 band normally forces 'neither' unless an exception is written: growth here is genuinely un-ignorable (43%/64% YoY, live not projected) -> exception invoked, thesis_fit '10x-in-2-3-years' allowed but conviction capped at Medium with an unconfirmed caveat per the decision table
